# WealthOrbit

> Financial intelligence for independent investors. Options education and
> market research built for self-directed Canadians.

WealthOrbit publishes an options course, a forward record of every trade idea
its system generates, and free market analysis tools. It is an education
business, not a signal service, and it does not give investment advice.

## What it publishes

- [Options Course](https://wealthorbit.ca/course/): 19 sessions, 7.8 hours,
  417 slides. Calls and puts through to pricing, the Greeks, spreads, trade
  selection, position sizing and process — finishing with Canadian registered
  account rules and the tax treatment of options income. Session 1 is free.
- [Idea Intelligence](https://wealthorbit.ca/idea-intelligence/): every idea
  graded A+ by the system, published the day it is generated, before the
  outcome is known. Winners and stopped-out trades alike. Never removed,
  never edited after publication.
- [Growth Intelligence](https://wealthorbit.ca/growth/): what a lump sum in
  any S&P 500 company would be worth today on a total-return basis, and the
  drawdowns a holder would have had to sit through.
- [Volatility Intelligence](https://wealthorbit.ca/volatility/): implied and
  historical volatility with 52-week ranks across a fixed US universe,
  updated daily.
- [Market Intelligence](https://wealthorbit.ca/markets/): indices, rates,
  commodities and the scheduled economic calendar.
- [Insurance](https://wealthorbit.ca/insurance/): life, critical illness,
  disability and segregated funds, under an LLQP licence.

## Position

The course states in its first session that profitability is not a learning
outcome. Completing it does not make anyone a profitable trader. What it
provides is a process for understanding what happened.

Published ideas are not recommendations and are not personalised. Because
only A+ graded ideas are published, the record cannot demonstrate that the
grading predicts outcomes — there is no comparison group.
